title: Ghazi main tujhse raazi
body:
Gazi mai raazi haa
GAAZI MAI RAAZI HAA GHAZI MEH RAAZI HAA GHAZI MEH RAAZI HAA
KEHNDHI EH
HAY KEHNDHI EH BAQIYA THO LOKO ABBAS DEE UJRI MAA
<<DIVIDER>>
GHAAZI MEH RAAZI HAA
OS KHABAR THO POORE YASRAB WICH WAD MAAN GAYE NEH MERE TERA SIR RAKHIYA EH JHOLI WICH ZAHRA NEH AKHRI WELE
TENOO PUTHAR HAY TENOO PUTHAR BHULANDI RAY BIBI
TERI CHUM CHUM KEH BAVAA
<<DIVIDER>>
MEH IK WARI TENOO DASIYA C THOO NAZRA NOO NAHI CHUKNA TENOO MAUT THO BAAD V YAAD REYA ZAINAB DA SIR NAHI TAKNA
NA SIR NEZE, HAY NA SIR NEZE TEH ROKIYA THOO
NA KOHLIYA THOO AKHIYAA
DASIYA HEH ROKAYA NEH MENOO THOO KEWE FARZ NIBHAYA PANI TEH KABZA KAR KEH V PANI NOO MOO NAHI LAYAA INJH PIYASIYAA, HAY INJH PIYASIYA REH KEH MERIYA V RAKH LAYA THOO IZTHAA
<<DIVIDER>>
CHODA SADIYAA THO KEHNDI EH ROO ROO ABBAS DEE AMBRI HON NAAM DEE UMAL BANIN HAA MEH PAWE JHOLI HEH MERI KHALI
PAR JEE KARDAY,HAY PAR JEE KARDAY MERA CHAN BACHRA BAS EHO AKHDI JAA
TERI GURBAT EH MEH JAANDI HAA BIN BAZOO ZEEN THO LATHIYAA PESHANI DEH BHAL DIGIYAA THOO RUKHSAR ZAMEEN TEH LAGIYAA
OS WELE,HAY OS WELE TEER MASH KEEZE TEH THOO NAZARA SAN RAKHIYAA
<<DIVIDER>>
SAQLAIN EH BIBI KEHDHI C PAWE ALAM NAHI MANSAB OHDA MEH WAPIS AHNDE KAFLE WICH EH MANZAR AAP EH TAKIYAA
ZAINAB DEH,HAY ZAINAB DEH SIR TEH KITHI C
TERE FAZAL NEH ALAM DEE CHAA
